P.expected_type: ∀ (K : Type*) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type*) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (rho : LR.L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x : LR.L) (y : LR.L) (h : LR.L) (v : V) (h_H001 : Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ l ∧ l < (p : ℤ)) (h_H002 : LR.ComplexHyp l rho x y h) (h_H003 : v ≠ 0 ∧ rho x v = 0 ∧ rho h v = (l : ℂ) • v) (h_H004 : LR.Admissible rho x y M), LR.Target K M rho x y h

correspondence.explanation: All parameters and H001–H004 are retained: arbitrary characteristic-p field K, 0≤l<p, the complex sl₂ module and Chevalley triple, chosen highest-weight vector, and arbitrary admissible lattice. ComplexHyp uses trace-zero 2×2 complex matrices, the spanning Chevalley triple, representation law, dimension l.toNat+1, nontriviality, irreducibility and existence of a highest-weight vector; H001 identifies l.toNat with the nonnegative integer l. Admissible records coincident integer/complex bases and preservation by every divided power. U_Z-stability implies this generator preservation; conversely preservation extends to its generated unital integer algebra by closure under addition, integer scalars, composition and identity. Submodule ℤ V represents the additive subgroup. The tensor flip identifies VK=K⊗ℤM with the source M⊗ℤK, preserving the K action, and similarly identifies K⊗ℤLZ with the source Lie algebra. Target asserts nontriviality and produces Action, whose onM_spec, red_spec, red_lie, Lift and gen_spec specify exactly the induced lattice Lie action and its three generators. These formulas uniquely determine the operators on pure tensors and hence everywhere. Thus Target yields the source assertion for the canonical action; conversely that assertion together with the constructed action gives Target. Nontriviality is equivalent to a nonzero vector, and bottom/top submodules mean zero/the whole space. Stability under the generators is equivalent to stability under their scalar-extended integer span, by linearity and closure of subspaces under linear combinations. T007/T010 construct Action; T020/T021 check the tensor conversions actually used, and T029 proves Target using the same action and transported basis from T025. No algebraic closure or separation of reduced weights is assumed, including l=0 and p=2.

proof_patches.T007:
classical
  constructor
  ·
    have ht := h_H002.1
    have hr := h_H002.2.2.1
    have hxy : ∀ m : V, m ∈ M → rho x m ∈ M ∧ rho y m ∈ M := by
      as_aux_lemma =>
        intro m hm
        simpa [LR.dp] using h_H004.2 1 m hm
    have hh : ∀ m : V, m ∈ M → rho h m ∈ M := by
      as_aux_lemma =>
        intro m hm
        rw [← ht.lie_e_f, hr]
        exact M.sub_mem (hxy _ (hxy m hm).2).1 (hxy _ (hxy m hm).1).2
    have hs : ∀ s ∈ LR.LZ x y h, ∀ m : V, m ∈ M → rho s m ∈ M := by
      as_aux_lemma =>
        intro s hs
        induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem s hs =>
          rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hs with rfl | hs
          · exact fun m hm => (hxy m hm).1
          rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hs with rfl | hs
          · exact fun m hm => (hxy m hm).2
          have : s = h := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hs
          subst s
          exact hh
        | zero => simp
        | add s t _ _ ihs iht =>
          intro m hm
          simpa using M.add_mem (ihs m hm) (iht m hm)
        | smul n s _ ih =>
          intro m hm
          simpa using M.smul_mem n (ih m hm)
    have hxmem : x ∈ LR.LZ x y h := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    have hymem : y ∈ LR.LZ x y h := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    have hhmem : h ∈ LR.LZ x y h := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    have hb : ∀ s t : LR.LZ x y h, ⁅(s : LR.L), (t : LR.L)⁆ ∈ LR.LZ x y h := by
      as_aux_lemma =>
        intro s t
        refine Submodule.span_induction₂ (p := fun a b _ _ => ⁅a,b⁆ ∈ LR.LZ x y h) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ s.property t.property
        · intro a b ha hb
          simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha hb
          rcases ha with ha | ha | ha <;> rcases hb with hb | hb | hb <;> rw [ha, hb]
          · simpa using (LR.LZ x y h).zero_mem
          · simpa [ht.lie_e_f] using hhmem
          · rw [← lie_skew x h, ht.lie_h_e_nsmul]
            simpa [two_smul] using (LR.LZ x y h).neg_mem ((LR.LZ x y h).add_mem hxmem hxmem)
          · rw [← lie_skew y x, ht.lie_e_f]
            exact (LR.LZ x y h).neg_mem hhmem
          · simpa using (LR.LZ x y h).zero_mem
          · rw [← lie_skew y h, ht.lie_h_f_nsmul, neg_neg]
            simpa [two_smul] using (LR.LZ x y h).add_mem hymem hymem
          · rw [ht.lie_h_e_nsmul]
            simpa [two_smul] using (LR.LZ x y h).add_mem hxmem hxmem
          · rw [ht.lie_h_f_nsmul]
            simpa [two_smul] using (LR.LZ x y h).neg_mem ((LR.LZ x y h).add_mem hymem hymem)
          · simpa using (LR.LZ x y h).zero_mem
        · intro b hb; simpa using (LR.LZ x y h).zero_mem
        · intro a ha; simpa using (LR.LZ x y h).zero_mem
        · intro a b c ha hb hc ih₁ ih₂
          simpa [add_lie] using (LR.LZ x y h).add_mem ih₁ ih₂
        · intro a b c ha hb hc ih₁ ih₂
          simpa [lie_add] using (LR.LZ x y h).add_mem ih₁ ih₂
        · intro n a b ha hb ih
          simpa using (LR.LZ x y h).smul_mem n ih
        · intro n a b ha hb ih
          simpa using (LR.LZ x y h).smul_mem n ih
    let onM : LR.LZ x y h →ₗ[ℤ] Module.End ℤ M :=
      { toFun := fun s => ((rho (s : LR.L)).restrictScalars ℤ).restrict (hs s s.property)
        map_add' := by intros; apply LinearMap.ext; intro m; apply Subtype.ext; simp
        map_smul' := by intros; apply LinearMap.ext; intro m; apply Subtype.ext; simp }
    have onM_spec : ∀ (s : LR.LZ x y h) (m : M), (onM s m : V) = rho (s : LR.L) (m : V) := by
      dsimp only [onM]
      as_aux_lemma =>
        intros; rfl
    let red : K ⊗[ℤ] LR.LZ x y h →ₗ[K] Module.End K (LR.VK K M) :=
      ((LinearMap.baseChangeHom ℤ K M M).comp onM).liftBaseChange K
    have redspec : ∀ (c d : K) (s : LR.LZ x y h) (m : M),
        red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] onM s m := by
      as_aux_lemma =>

1: # Retained authors, immutable interfaces and proof repair
2: 
3: This protocol is generic. No domain, historical node ID or particular notation
4: activates a repair. Task names below describe responsibilities, not a new ID scheme.
5: 
6: ## Preprocessing author and independent reviewer
7: 
8: The controller verifies actual accepted NL0/A authority, then retains one author
9: through optional shared extraction and interface construction. A no-change decision
10: skips incremental review. A changed source gets actual producer/substitution review
11: by the separate retained preprocessing reviewer. Located failures return to that
12: same author; changed candidates return to that same reviewer. Operational faults
13: pause rather than masquerading as mathematical revision requests.
14: 
15: The reviewer next checks the complete typed contract and plan: every external E
16: and full P including all hypotheses, quantifiers and domains; relevant definitions,
17: structure fields, library parameter/index meanings, coercions and nonvacuity. Read
18: the actual pinned definitions instead of guessing from notation. A well-typed
19: encoding may still strengthen or weaken the source. The reviewer is independent
20: of the author, while retaining its own earlier findings; disclose both facts.
21: 
22: Only a complete actual passing semantic receipt opens freeze and proof dispatch.
23: Freeze source, pins, complete endpoint types and the meaning-determining header.
24: Save the handoff and close both preprocessing roles. An unchanged rejected proposal
25: does not justify repeated reviews. This semantic authority is inherited at final
26: machine acceptance only when the actual final artifact still matches it.
27: 
28: ## Local proof work
29: 
30: Each node has its own retained author. Ordinary compiler/API/tactic feedback stays
31: with that author. A 300-second native timeout or heartbeat failure retains the
32: candidate and supplies frozen ST020 advice in the failed tool result. Isolate the
33: expensive application, repair and recheck the unchanged target. There is no total
34: case, token, call, repair-round or turn allowance by default.
35: 
36: `report_proof_obstruction` records a concrete alleged layer, explanation, resolving
37: packet locations and actual own candidate evidence. An allegation is not a proved
38: interface defect. Preserve healthy siblings and let already active work reach its
39: normal handoff. No fixed count of idle replies retires the round, cancels queued
40: jobs or changes inputs. Progress counters remain passive measurement.
41: 
42: After local assignments reach handoffs, the serial connection author may diagnose
43: a reported global issue using its actual source/formal pair and selected own
44: attempts. It may repair internal proof bodies, proved local helpers, parameter
45: applications, library discharges and proof connections. It cannot change frozen
46: E/P, their hypotheses or definitions determining their meaning. A missing producer
47: cannot become an assumption. Ordinary local repair returns to the owning author.
48: 
49: A located frozen-contract defect, source gap or unresolved mathematical obstruction
50: pauses with saved evidence for the user. No automatic unfreeze, source rewrite,
51: whole-workflow restart or new model/profile is authorized. Repeated identical
52: obligation/evidence after a located advice handoff stays an explicit checkpoint;
53: it is not a reason to resample a diagnostic or declare mathematical impossibility.
54: 
55: ## Assembly and final machine acceptance
56: 
57: Attempt mechanical assembly first. If it fails with an actual connection error,
58: use the connection author under the immutable contract. Recheck the complete
59: standalone file, all internal producer dependencies and actual kernel trust.
60: No `sorry`, undeclared project premise or unproved substitute may remain.
61: 
62: Normal final Audit B checks actual full E/P types by native definitional equality,
63: exact frozen header/pins and bound semantic authority, plus complete proof closure.
64: It calls no final semantic model. Its receipt says `FROZEN_INTERFACE_SEMANTICS_INHERITED`,
65: not that a new independent final review took place. Source qualifications remain.
66: 
67: Only a valid proof with genuine endpoint/meaning drift may open B-final. Missing
68: compilation, changed provenance, missing dependencies or `sorry` cannot use this
69: exception. Actual B-final fidelity PASS permits warning-qualified delivery and
70: records the freeze-integrity defect. A nonpass pauses locally and asks the user:
71: 
72: - `deliver-actual`: deliver the compiled statement and findings, explicitly **not**
73:   completion of the original target.
74: - `recheck`: perform the explicitly requested new detailed semantic review, keeping
75:   earlier findings, costs and its actual review scope in the evidence.
76: - `reset-translation`: release translation processes, remove translation-generated
77:   source/native/temp files, retain original NL0/A and cost ledgers, and rerun only
78:   translation. Report the freeze defect to developers.
79: 
80: These are exact-incident `yui.py final-decision` controls displayed in the offline
81: pause report. None is automatic. A stale incident, changed owner, changed artifact
82: or unconfirmed owned-process cleanup blocks the action. User cancellation remains
83: available. A user acceptance of files never grants fidelity or original-goal PASS.
84: 
85: ## Evidence and lifetimes
86: 
87: A submission is a durable handoff, followed by a confirmed native turn interrupt;
88: its role waits without another provider request. The native thread is reused for
89: that role's next assignment. Only the specified accepted handoff closes a role;
90: a fault preserves the carrier, drafts and diagnostics. Controller-authenticated
91: restoration of an interrupted dynamic-tool result is logged and hash-bound; unknown
92: calls or altered history remain rejected.
93: 
94: Reuse only exact checked contexts. Successful bodies copied between retained proof
95: runs are candidates until current Lean checks accept them. Save rejected drafts,
96: actual retries/waits and all reported usage. Selected proof rounds use bound
97: `proof-selection.json`; retained earlier failures are not free or new successes.
98: Missing usage or actual service tier remains unknown; cached/reasoning tokens are
99: subsets. Owner monitoring is bounded read-only observation and supplies no hints.

correspondence.explanation: All parameters and H001–H004 are retained: arbitrary characteristic-p field K, 0≤l<p, the complex sl₂ module and Chevalley triple, chosen highest-weight vector, and arbitrary admissible lattice. ComplexHyp uses trace-zero 2×2 complex matrices, the spanning Chevalley triple, representation law, dimension l.toNat+1, nontriviality, irreducibility and existence of a highest-weight vector; H001 identifies l.toNat with the nonnegative integer l. Admissible records coincident integer/complex bases and preservation by every divided power. U_Z-stability implies this generator preservation; conversely preservation extends to its generated unital integer algebra by closure under addition, integer scalars, composition and identity. Submodule ℤ V represents the additive subgroup. The tensor flip identifies VK=K⊗ℤM with the source M⊗ℤK, preserving the K action, and similarly identifies K⊗ℤLZ with the source Lie algebra. Target asserts nontriviality and produces Action, whose onM_spec, red_spec, red_lie, Lift and gen_spec specify exactly the induced lattice Lie action and its three generators. These formulas uniquely determine the operators on pure tensors and hence everywhere. Thus Target yields the source assertion for the canonical action; conversely that assertion together with the constructed action gives Target. Nontriviality is equivalent to a nonzero vector, and bottom/top submodules mean zero/the whole space. Stability under the generators is equivalent to stability under their scalar-extended integer span, by linearity and closure of subspaces under linear combinations. T007/T010 construct Action; T020/T021 check the tensor conversions actually used, and T029 proves Target using the same action and transported basis from T025. No algebraic closure or separation of reduced weights is assumed, including l=0 and p=2.

correspondence.explanation: All parameters and H001–H004 are retained: arbitrary characteristic-p field K, 0≤l<p, the complex sl₂ module and Chevalley triple, chosen highest-weight vector, and arbitrary admissible lattice. ComplexHyp uses trace-zero 2×2 complex matrices, the spanning Chevalley triple, representation law, dimension l.toNat+1, nontriviality, irreducibility and existence of a highest-weight vector; H001 identifies l.toNat with the nonnegative integer l. Admissible records coincident integer/complex bases and preservation by every divided power. U_Z-stability implies this generator preservation; conversely preservation extends to its generated unital integer algebra by closure under addition, integer scalars, composition and identity. Submodule ℤ V represents the additive subgroup. The tensor flip identifies VK=K⊗ℤM with the source M⊗ℤK, preserving the K action, and similarly identifies K⊗ℤLZ with the source Lie algebra. Target asserts nontriviality and produces Action, whose onM_spec, red_spec, red_lie, Lift and gen_spec specify exactly the induced lattice Lie action and its three generators. These formulas uniquely determine the operators on pure tensors and hence everywhere. Thus Target yields the source assertion for the canonical action; conversely that assertion together with the constructed action gives Target. Nontriviality is equivalent to a nonzero vector, and bottom/top submodules mean zero/the whole space. Stability under the generators is equivalent to stability under their scalar-extended integer span, by linearity and closure of subspaces under linear combinations. T007/T010 construct Action; T020/T021 check the tensor conversions actually used, and T029 proves Target using the same action and transported basis from T025. No algebraic closure or separation of reduced weights is assumed, including l=0 and p=2.

correspondence.explanation: All parameters and H001–H004 are retained: arbitrary characteristic-p field K, 0≤l<p, the complex sl₂ module and Chevalley triple, chosen highest-weight vector, and arbitrary admissible lattice. ComplexHyp uses trace-zero 2×2 complex matrices, the spanning Chevalley triple, representation law, dimension l.toNat+1, nontriviality, irreducibility and existence of a highest-weight vector; H001 identifies l.toNat with the nonnegative integer l. Admissible records coincident integer/complex bases and preservation by every divided power. U_Z-stability implies this generator preservation; conversely preservation extends to its generated unital integer algebra by closure under addition, integer scalars, composition and identity. Submodule ℤ V represents the additive subgroup. The tensor flip identifies VK=K⊗ℤM with the source M⊗ℤK, preserving the K action, and similarly identifies K⊗ℤLZ with the source Lie algebra. Target asserts nontriviality and produces Action, whose onM_spec, red_spec, red_lie, Lift and gen_spec specify exactly the induced lattice Lie action and its three generators. These formulas uniquely determine the operators on pure tensors and hence everywhere. Thus Target yields the source assertion for the canonical action; conversely that assertion together with the constructed action gives Target. Nontriviality is equivalent to a nonzero vector, and bottom/top submodules mean zero/the whole space. Stability under the generators is equivalent to stability under their scalar-extended integer span, by linearity and closure of subspaces under linear combinations. T007/T010 construct Action; T020/T021 check the tensor conversions actually used, and T029 proves Target using the same action and transported basis from T025. No algebraic closure or separation of reduced weights is assumed, including l=0 and p=2.

  let profile : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
    let env ← Lean.getEnv
    if !(env.contains `Translation.T001) then return
    let emit (s : String) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
      let out ← IO.getStdout
      out.putStrLn ("ASSEMBLY_PROFILE " ++ s)
      out.flush
    let steps ← IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let started ← IO.mkRef (← IO.monoMsNow)
    let rec uses (fuel : Nat) (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
      match fuel with
      | 0 => throwError "diagnostic expression depth"
      | n+1 =>
        let k ← steps.get
        steps.set (k+1)
        if k % 1024 == 0 then
          if (← IO.monoMsNow) - (← started.get) > 2000 then
            throwError "diagnostic traversal exceeded two seconds"
        match e with
        | .const name _ =>
          let ci ← Lean.getConstInfo name
          discard <| Lean.Meta.isProp ci.type
        | .app .. =>
          let fn := e.getAppFn
          uses n fn
          let mut type ← Lean.Meta.inferType fn
          for arg in e.getAppArgs do
            if !type.isForall then type ← Lean.Meta.whnf type
            match type with
            | .forallE _ _ body _ =>
              uses n arg
              type := body.instantiate1 arg
            | _ => throwError "diagnostic application binder"
        | .lam name type body bi | .forallE name type body bi =>
          uses n type
          Lean.Meta.withLocalDecl name bi type fun x => uses n (body.instantiate1 x)
        | .letE name type value body _ =>
          uses n type
          uses n value
          Lean.Meta.withLetDecl name type value fun x => uses n (body.instantiate1 x)
        | .mdata _ value | .proj _ _ value => uses n value
        | _ => pure ()
    let mut pending : Array Lean.Name := #[`Translation.T028, `Translation.T027, `Translation.T026,
      `Translation.T025, `Translation.T024, `Translation.T023, `Translation.T022, `Translation.T021,

      `Translation.T005, `Translation.T004, `Translation.T003, `Translation.T002, `Translation.T001]
    let mut seen : Lean.NameSet := {}
    let mut count := 0
    while !pending.isEmpty && count < 150 do
      let name := pending.back!
      pending := pending.pop
      if seen.contains name then continue
      seen := seen.insert name
      count := count+1
      let ci ← Lean.getConstInfo name
      let imported := env.isImportedConst name
      emit s!"BEGIN {name} imported={imported}"
      let start ← IO.monoMsNow
      if !imported then
        if let some value := ci.value? (allowOpaque := true) then
          steps.set 0
          started.set start
          try
            uses 10000 value
            emit s!"USES {name} ms={(← IO.monoMsNow)-start} nodes={← steps.get}"
          catch _ =>
            emit s!"USES_LIMIT {name} ms={(← IO.monoMsNow)-start} nodes={← steps.get}"
      let t ← IO.monoMsNow
      let s ← Lean.withOptions (fun o => (o.setBool `pp.all true).setBool `pp.universes true) do

10: ## Entry and immutable inputs
11: 
12: Require all planned proof bodies, exact interface/plan/source bindings and the
13: accepted NL0/Audit A authority. A missing producer or failed local job keeps
14: assembly blocked, even if all its consumers passed conditionally. Revalidate
15: the existing authority; do not rerun unchanged Audit A.

17: The author receives this problem's actual proof bundle, frozen contract/plan,
18: original H/E/M/N/P/D inventory, source-output map and own saved assembly
19: feedback. It may read its own checked proof bodies. Other cases, developer
20: history and hidden reference proofs remain unavailable. Do not preload all
21: background notes; retain their node-local reference locations.
22: 
23: ## Connection rules
24: 
25: 1. **Close the implementation DAG.** Use the frozen topological order and exact
26:    parameter/binder order. Supply each internal input with its actual checked
27:    producer; preserve implicit and instance arguments. Source-facing N outputs
28:    must use their recorded T realizations. Never replace a missing producer by
29:    an assumption, placeholder, opaque proof or changed target.
30: 2. **Discharge retained M ports.** Supply a real Lean proof of each port in
31:    `library_terms`, preserving required H/E. Any proved result in the pinned
32:    Mathlib environment may be used; no matching source-M name, library signature
33:    copy or permission ledger is required. New interfaces should normally apply
34:    the library directly and omit unnecessary M ports. A declaration name alone
35:    cannot discharge an assumption.
36: 3. **Export the original interface.** Retain all original H/E, parameters and
37:    definitions; remove M as assumptions by supplying the library proofs. Do
38:    not change representations, domains or hypotheses to force a match. The
39:    generator inspects the conditional theorem's actual universe parameters.
40:    Those occurring in retained parameters/H/E/conclusion are inferred from
41:    that interface. Only implementation-only levels absent from the retained
42:    interface are instantiated at zero at this application site; the general
43:    library declarations stay intact. Elaborate the generated assembled root
44:    synchronously (`set_option Elab.async false in`) so proof-only universe
45:    parameters are included at declaration commit. This does not serialize
46:    separate proof workers. Compile the
47:    result; do not guess that implicit inference succeeded.
48: 4. **Build a standalone artifact.** `Proof.lean` contains definitions, actual
49:    local proofs, connected conditional root, checked library discharges and
50:    final `AuditBExport.P`. It is compiled before audit instrumentation is
51:    appended. `assembly.json` and `assembly-compiler.json` record that real
52:    complete-file outcome. A conditional fragment is not this gate.
53: 5. **Prepare actual audit evidence.** After standalone assembly passes, inspect
54:    actual E/P kernel signatures and root closure. Carry short author
55:    correspondence notes for every E and complete P; relevant definitions and
56:    hidden fields remain visible to the independent reviewer. Save `Audit.lean`, `compiler.json`, `inspection.json`,
57:    correspondence, source/proof hashes and the review packet. Inspection uses the configured single-native-call limit and Lean heartbeat policy. An explicitly requested cutoff or
58:    actual execution failure is an incomplete inspection, not a mathematical
59:    rejection. Full endpoint fidelity and kernel trust checks still apply.
60: 
61: ## Repair and handoff
62: 
63: Use `check_draft` for actual feedback and keep the saved candidate. The result
64: identifies the candidate and failing layer; compiler errors precede long
65: printed types. `read_assembly_feedback` reads only this author's candidate,
66: generated Lean, full compiler output or mechanical records in bounded pages.
67: Follow pagination when a short excerpt is insufficient. Correct legitimate
68: mapping/library-application/connection errors without restarting proof authors.
69: For library applications or representation conversions, follow the same
70: [Lean implementation safeguards](lean-writing.md) used during local proof work.
71: Submitting the identical checked candidate reuses its exact hash-checked native
72: result; this does not create a semantic review or a new PASS.
73: 
74: The optional `proof_patches` object maps existing T IDs to replacement internal
75: tactic bodies. It cannot create a missing node or change contract/plan/E/P or
76: meaning-determining definitions. Native-check the complete patched proof bundle.
77: Internal auxiliary lemmas may be proved inside those bodies; no new premise is
78: allowed. Ordinary local body defects return to their owning authors; global
79: proof connection is this author's responsibility.
80: 
81: An actual frozen-interface or source-premise defect pauses for the user; no
82: automatic unfreeze/rewrite is authorized. A generator/tool defect is execution engineering; report the concrete
83: diagnostic and preserve the draft if it is outside the author's allowed edits.
84: Do not report a source paper unavailable merely because a short log was cut,
85: or call an unlocated name-format rejection a mathematical gap. No routine
86: progress essay or periodic model continuation is required.
87: 
88: Hand off only after **standalone assembly and mechanical inspection pass**.
89: The machine validates frozen full E/P, relevant definitions and complete proof
90: closure under [Audit B](audit-b.md). A proof-valid contract deviation instead
91: requires actual B-final semantic review and warning-qualified delivery. It receives
92: no author's suggested verdict; it cannot override invalid proof evidence.
93: `ASSEMBLY-PASSED`, `AUDIT-B-MECHANICAL-PASSED` and a structurally accepted mapping

import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace LR
abbrev L := LieAlgebra.SpecialLinear.sl (Fin 2) ℂ
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b}
abbrev C (p : ℕ) := RestrictScalars (R p) ℚ ℂ
def cv (p : ℕ) : C p ≃+ ℂ := RestrictScalars.addEquiv (R p) ℚ ℂ
abbrev I (l : ℤ) := Fin (l.toNat + 1)
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
noncomputable def dp {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V := ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r

variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
noncomputable def eNat (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
def Stable {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (W : Submodule F A) (f : Module.End F A) : Prop := ∀ w ∈ W, f w ∈ W
def ComplexHyp (l : ℤ) (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  IsSl2Triple h x y ∧ Submodule.span ℂ ({x,y,h} : Set L) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ s t : L, rho ⁅s,t⁆ = rho s * rho t - rho t * rho s) ∧
  FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = l.toNat + 1 ∧
  Nontrivial V ∧
  (∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, (∀ t : L, Stable W (rho t)) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) ∧
  (∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ rho x w = 0 ∧ rho h w = (l : ℂ) • w)
def Admissible (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y : L) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (ι : Type) (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ M) (bc : Module.Basis ι ℂ V), ∀ i, (b i : V) = bc i) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp (rho x) r m ∈ M ∧ dp (rho y) r m ∈ M)
def Strings (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, t ((d ^ r) v) = ((l : ℂ) - 2 * (r : ℂ)) • (d ^ r) v) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → a ((d ^ r) v) = ((r : ℂ) * ((l : ℂ) - (r : ℂ) + 1)) • (d ^ (r-1)) v)
def BasisString (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val) ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, l.toNat < r → (d ^ r) v = 0)
def Matrices {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End F A) (e : ℕ → A) : Prop :=
  a (e 0) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ l.toNat → a (e i) = ((l : F) - (i : F) + 1) • e (i-1)) ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i < l.toNat → d (e i) = ((i : F)+1) • e (i+1)) ∧
  d (e l.toNat) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat → t (e i) = ((l : F) - 2*(i : F)) • e i)
def DividedMatrices (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ r i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat →
    dp a r (eNat d v i) =
      (if r ≤ i then (Nat.choose (l.toNat-i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i-r) else 0) ∧
    dp d r (eNat d v i) =
      (if i+r ≤ l.toNat then (Nat.choose (i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i+r) else 0)
def N1 (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < l+1 ∧ Fintype.card (I l) = (l+1).toNat ∧ Strings l a d t v ∧
  BasisString l d v ∧ Matrices l a d t (eNat d v) ∧ DividedMatrices l a d v
noncomputable def unit (l : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) (i j : I l) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def BasisSpec (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val
def LocalRingSpec (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b) ∧
  (∀ b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → IsUnit (b : R p))
def SmallUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat → ¬ p ∣ r.factorial ∧ IsUnit (r.factorial : R p)) ∧
  (∀ j : I l, IsUnit (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : R p))
def IotaSpec (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  (∀ (r : R p) (m : M), f (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ (r : R p) (z : MR p M), f (r • z) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • f z)
def LocalBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective f ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range f) = ⊤
def Preserved (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp a r m ∈ M ∧ dp d r m ∈ M) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ z : MR p M, dp a r (f z) ∈ Set.range f ∧ dp d r (f z) ∈ Set.range f)
def UnitIdentities (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat = unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) = unit l b i (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val) = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) j
def AllUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V)
    (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    unit l b i j = ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val)) ∧
    (∀ z : MR p M, unit l b i j (f z) ∈ Set.range f)

abbrev LZ (x y h : L) := Submodule.span ℤ ({x,y,h} : Set L)
def Lift (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) (g : Module.End K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  ∃ fm : Module.End ℤ M, (∀ m : M, (fm m : V) = f (m : V)) ∧
    (∀ (c : K) (m : M), g (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (fm m))
structure Action (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) where
  onM : LZ x y h →ₗ[ℤ] Module.End ℤ M
  onM_spec : ∀ s : LZ x y h, ∀ m : M, (onM s m : V) = rho (s : L) (m : V)
  bracket_mem : ∀ s t : LZ x y h, ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ ∈ LZ x y h
  red : K ⊗[ℤ] LZ x y h →ₗ[K] Module.End K (VK K M)
  red_spec : ∀ (c d : K) (s : LZ x y h) (m : M),
    red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] onM s m
  red_lie : ∀ s t u : LZ x y h, (u : L) = ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ → ∀ c d : K,
    red ((c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) = red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) * red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) - red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) * red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s)
  a : Module.End K (VK K M)
  d : Module.End K (VK K M)
  t : Module.End K (VK K M)
  a_spec : Lift K M (rho x) a
  d_spec : Lift K M (rho y) d
  t_spec : Lift K M (rho h) t
  gen_spec : ∀ (s : LZ x y h),
    ((s : L) = x → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = a) ∧
    ((s : L) = y → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = d) ∧
    ((s : L) = h → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = t)
def N2 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) : Prop :=
  LocalRingSpec p ∧ SmallUnits p l ∧ Nonempty (Action K M rho x y h) ∧
  ∃ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f ∧ LocalBasis p l M f ∧
    Preserved p M f (rho x) (rho y) ∧
    (∀ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, BasisSpec l (rho y) v b →
      UnitIdentities l (rho x) (rho y) b ∧ AllUnits p l M f (rho x) (rho y) b)
def CoeffSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (i : I l) (c : ℂ), (cv p).symm c ∈ J ↔ c • eNat d v i.val ∈ Set.range f) ∧
  J.FG ∧ J ≠ ⊥ ∧
  ∃ D : (I l → J) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M, ∀ g : I l → J, f (D g) = ∑ i, cv p (g i : C p) • eNat d v i.val
def MuSpec (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) (mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J), mu (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * cv p (c : C p)
def RationalEmbedding (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) ∧
  ∃ mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ, MuSpec p J mu ∧ Function.Injective mu ∧
    LinearMap.range mu = Submodule.span ℚ ((cv p) '' (J : Set (C p)))
def ScaledBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M), ∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat d v i.val
def CyclicSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∃ b : ℂ, (cv p).symm b ∈ J ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b}) ∧
  (∀ b : ℂ, (cv p).symm b ∈ J → b ≠ 0 → J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b} → ScaledBasis p l d v M f b)
def N3 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f →
    ∃ J : Submodule (R p) (C p), CoeffSpec p l d v M f J ∧ RationalEmbedding p J ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) = 1 ∧ CyclicSpec p l d v M f J
def RationalMultiples (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : ℂ, (cv p).symm a ∈ J → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, (cv p).symm c ∈ J → ∃ q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
def PDecomposition (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 → ∃ (nu : ℤ) (u : (R p)ˣ), q = (p : ℚ)^nu * (u.val : ℚ)
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
  ∃ A : Action K M rho x y h, ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
    Stable W A.a → Stable W A.d → Stable W A.t → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤

structure Residue (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] where
  phi : R p →+* K
  psi : R p →+* ZMod p
  kappa : ZMod p →+* K
  phi_fraction : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
    (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / b → phi r = (a : K) * (b : K)⁻¹
  psi_fraction : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
    (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / b → psi r = (a : ZMod p) * (b : ZMod p)⁻¹
  kappa_int : ∀ a : ℤ, kappa (a : ZMod p) = (a : K)
  compatible : phi = kappa.comp psi
  psi_surjective : Function.Surjective psi
  psi_kernel : RingHom.ker psi = Ideal.span {(p : R p)}
  eps : (R p) ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : R p)} ≃+* ZMod p
  eps_spec : ∀ r : R p, eps (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(p : R p)}) r) = psi r
  units_nonzero : ∀ u : (R p)ˣ, phi u.val ≠ 0
def GammaPure (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra (R p) K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (phi : R p →+* K) (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M) : Prop :=
  (∀ (c : K) (m : M), G (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
  (∀ (c : K) (r : R p) (m : M), G.symm (c ⊗ₜ[R p] (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) = (phi r*c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
def DeltaPure (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra (R p) K] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) (D : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), D (c ⊗ₜ[R p] z) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p z) ∧
  (∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), D.symm (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p z) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] z)
def Bridge (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  letI := Q.kappa.toAlgebra
  ∃ (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
    (D : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)),
    GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧ DeltaPure p K M D ∧
    (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (z : VK K M),
      G (F.baseChange K z) = ((F.baseChange (R p)).baseChange K) (G z)) ∧
    (∀ F : Module.End (R p) (MR p M),
      ∃ Fb : Module.End (ZMod p) (ModN (MR p M) p),
        (∀ z : MR p M, Fb (ModN.mkQ p z) = ModN.mkQ p (F z)) ∧
        (∀ z : K ⊗[R p] MR p M, D (F.baseChange K z) = Fb.baseChange K (D z)))
noncomputable def extend {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (l : ℤ)
    (b : Module.Basis (I l) F A) (k : ℕ) : A :=
  if hk : k < l.toNat+1 then b ⟨k,hk⟩ else 0
def polynomial {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End F A) (i j : I l) : Module.End F A :=
  (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : F)⁻¹ •
    (((((l.toNat-i.val).factorial : F)⁻¹) • a^(l.toNat-i.val)) *
    (((l.toNat.factorial : F)⁻¹) • d^l.toNat) *
    (((l.toNat.factorial : F)⁻¹) • a^l.toNat) *
    (((((l.toNat-j.val).factorial : F)⁻¹) • d^(l.toNat-j.val))))
def ReducedBasisSpec (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (A : Action K M rho x y h)
    (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat+1 ∧
  Matrices l A.a A.d A.t (extend l beta) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat →
    (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧
    Lift K M (dp (rho x) r) (((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • A.a^r) ∧
    Lift K M (dp (rho y) r) (((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • A.d^r)) ∧
  (∀ i j : I l, (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ k : I l, polynomial l A.a A.d i j (beta k) = if k = j then beta i else 0)
def Transfer (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ), IotaSpec p M f → ScaledBasis p l d v M f b →
    ∃ (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
      (B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)),
      GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧
      (∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat d v i.val) ∧
      (∀ i, beta i = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R p] B i)) ∧
      Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat+1
def ReducedPackage (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ A : Action K M rho x y h,
    ∃ (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) (b : ℂ)
      (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
      (B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)),
      IotaSpec p M f ∧ Function.Injective f ∧ CoeffSpec p l (rho y) v M f J ∧
      (cv p).symm b ∈ J ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b} ∧
      GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧
      (∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat (rho y) v i.val) ∧
      (∀ i, beta i = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R p] B i)) ∧
      ReducedBasisSpec l K M rho x y h A beta
def N4 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ Q : Residue p K, Bridge p K M Q ∧ ReducedPackage p l K M rho x y h v Q

def DividedLiftMatrices (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  ∀ r : ℕ, ∃ xr yr : Module.End K (VK K M), Lift K M (dp a r) xr ∧ Lift K M (dp d r) yr ∧
    ∀ i : I l,
      xr (beta i) = (if r ≤ i.val then (Nat.choose (l.toNat-i.val+r) r : K) • extend l beta (i.val-r) else 0) ∧
      yr (beta i) = (if i.val+r ≤ l.toNat then (Nat.choose (i.val+r) r : K) • extend l beta (i.val+r) else 0)
def MatrixTransport (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ (A : Action K M rho x y h) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ)
    (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
    (B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)),
    IotaSpec p M f → Function.Injective f → b ≠ 0 → GammaPure p K M Q.phi G →
    (∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat (rho y) v i.val) →
    (∀ i, beta i = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R p] B i)) →
    Matrices l A.a A.d A.t (extend l beta) ∧ DividedLiftMatrices l K M (rho x) (rho y) beta
def SmallPowers (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : Action K M rho x y h) (r : ℕ), r ≤ l.toNat →
    (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧ Lift K M (dp (rho x) r) (((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • A.a^r) ∧
    Lift K M (dp (rho y) r) (((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • A.d^r)
def PolynomialTransport (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ (A : Action K M rho x y h) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ)
    (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
    (B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)),
    IotaSpec p M f → Function.Injective f → b ≠ 0 → GammaPure p K M Q.phi G →
    (∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat (rho y) v i.val) →
    (∀ i, beta i = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R p] B i)) →
    ∀ i j : I l, (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ k : I l, polynomial l A.a A.d i j (beta k) = if k = j then beta i else 0
end LR

correspondence.explanation: All parameters and H001–H004 are retained: arbitrary characteristic-p field K, 0≤l<p, the complex sl₂ module and Chevalley triple, chosen highest-weight vector, and arbitrary admissible lattice. ComplexHyp uses trace-zero 2×2 complex matrices, the spanning Chevalley triple, representation law, dimension l.toNat+1, nontriviality, irreducibility and existence of a highest-weight vector; H001 identifies l.toNat with the nonnegative integer l. Admissible records coincident integer/complex bases and preservation by every divided power. U_Z-stability implies this generator preservation; conversely preservation extends to its generated unital integer algebra by closure under addition, integer scalars, composition and identity. Submodule ℤ V represents the additive subgroup. The tensor flip identifies VK=K⊗ℤM with the source M⊗ℤK, preserving the K action, and similarly identifies K⊗ℤLZ with the source Lie algebra. Target asserts nontriviality and produces Action, whose onM_spec, red_spec, red_lie, Lift and gen_spec specify exactly the induced lattice Lie action and its three generators. These formulas uniquely determine the operators on pure tensors and hence everywhere. Thus Target yields the source assertion for the canonical action; conversely that assertion together with the constructed action gives Target. Nontriviality is equivalent to a nonzero vector, and bottom/top submodules mean zero/the whole space. Stability under the generators is equivalent to stability under their scalar-extended integer span, by linearity and closure of subspaces under linear combinations. T007/T010 construct Action; T020/T021 check the tensor conversions actually used, and T029 proves Target using the same action and transported basis from T025. No algebraic closure or separation of reduced weights is assumed, including l=0 and p=2.
